## How this was verified

<!--
The commands actually run and what was observed — not what should happen.

A successful build is not verification of firmware behaviour. CI compiles every
pull request, and a green check means the image links, not that the panel does
anything. If the change touches the firmware, flash a panel and say what
appeared on the screen.

If you could not test on hardware, write that here in plain words instead of
leaving the section thin. An unverified change is reviewable; an unverified
change described as working is not.
-->
